column1: # The verdict each fixture must get on each property, under each fairness variant, tab-separated.
# Every cell the harness computes must have a row here, and every row a cell: an unpinned cell fails the run.
# verdict: holds or violated (for reachable, holds means a state where the decision is TRUE was reached).
# path: for an always or reachable property, the shortest counterexample or witness every column must print, as reference labels; - for none.
#   For stays and eventually the columns print lassos, which the harness replays and checks instead of comparing them (see README.md).
# source: where the expectation comes from.
#   brief: the probes' P1 to P4 table (REGULATIVE-LOWERING-SPEC.md sections 1 and 7, brief/README.md); P1 on D1 is the positive control.
#   wp3: the verdicts TLC 2.19 and NuSMV 2.7.0 gave on the emitted models on 2026-10-26, recorded in brief/README.md ("The emitted models").
#   measured: first measured by this harness on 2026-10-26, with no record before it; its oracle is the three columns agreeing.
